sn36.6:1.1: assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano sukhampi vedanaṃ vediyati, dukkhampi vedanaṃ vediyati, adukkhamasukhampi vedanaṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:1.2: sutavā bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sukhampi vedanaṃ vediyati, dukkhampi vedanaṃ vediyati, adukkhamasukhampi vedanaṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:1.3: tatra bhikkhave ko viseso, ko adhippāyo kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti?
sn36.6:1.4: bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavannettikā bhagavampaṭisaraṇā, sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhu dhāressantīti. tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti. evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ, bhagavā etadavoca:
sn36.6:1.5: assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
sn36.6:1.9: tamenaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ vijjheyyuṃ evaṃ
sn36.6:1.10: hi so bhikkhave, puriso dve sallena vedanā vediyetha.
sn36.6:1.11: evameva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati. kilamati. paridevati. urattāḷiṃ kandati. sammohaṃ āpajjati.
sn36.6:1.14: tassāyeva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno paṭighavā hoti.
sn36.6:1.15: tamenaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavantaṃ yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo so anuseti.
sn36.6:1.16: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāmasukhaṃ abhinandati.
sn36.6:1.18: na bhikkhave pajānāti assutavā puthujjano aññatra kāmasukhā dukkhāya vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ,
sn36.6:1.19: tassa kāmasukhaṃ abhinandato yo sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo so anuseti.
sn36.6:1.20: so tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
sn36.6:1.21: tassa tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo so anuseti.
sn36.6:1.22: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, saññutto naṃ vedayati.
sn36.6:1.23: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, saññutto naṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:1.24: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, saññutto naṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:1.25: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano saññutto jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi saññutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn36.6:2.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati:
sn36.6:3.2: tamenaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ na vijjheyyuṃ; evaṃ
sn36.6:3.3: hi so bhikkhave puriso ekaṃ sallena vedanaṃ vediyetha
sn36.6:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati, na kilamati, na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati;
sn36.6:3.7: tassāyeva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavā na hoti.
sn36.6:3.8: tamenaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya apaṭighavantaṃ yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo so nānuseti;
sn36.6:3.9: so dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāmasukhaṃ nābhinandati.
sn36.6:3.11: pajānāti hi bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako aññatra kāmasukhā dukkhāya vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ.
sn36.6:3.12: tassa kāmasukhaṃ anabhinandato yo sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo so nānuseti.
sn36.6:3.13: so tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn36.6:3.14: tassa tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānato, yo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo so nānuseti.
sn36.6:3.15: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:3.16: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:3.17: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ vediyati.
sn36.6:3.18: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako visaññutto jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, visaññutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
sn36.6:3.19: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso, ayaṃ adhippāyo, idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti.
